verdict.rationale: PayPal Checkout is a vendor-hosted button/flow where customers select PayPal and pay via any linked funding source without the merchant building a custom payment UI, and Invoicing similarly offers a 'secure PayPal payment page, without building their own payment flow.' Docs also cover the customizable/expanded checkout options and server-side endpoints for refunds/voids, showing depth of integration guidance. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on conversion-rate evidence or third-party corroboration of the 'conversion-optimized' claim beyond PayPal's own marketing.
